scenes.conflict: Orlan fears the elders' reprisal and the risk of the journey, and Iselle dismisses his caution because the numbers seem to settle everything.
scenes.goal: Iselle wants to confirm her decay-pattern map and win Orlan's backing to present it to all four enclaves.
scenes.outcome: The pattern is confirmed and Orlan reluctantly agrees to help, but the Circle's elders learn of her charts.
scenes.summary: In the Lumenvale bell-tower archive, Iselle overlays her charts and sees the skybridge fraying follows a pattern radiating from the southern span. She predicts the next span to fail and shows Orlan.
scenes.title: The Pattern in the Archive

scenes.conflict: The elders protect the sealed archive, and Iselle's stubbornness hardens into defiance while she suspects the archive is part of the problem.
scenes.goal: Iselle wants permission to present her maps to the other isles.
scenes.outcome: Permission is denied. Iselle and Orlan resolve to leave secretly for the bridges at dawn.
scenes.summary: The Circle's elders summon Iselle, forbid her from sharing the sealed archive charts, and threaten Orlan's guild standing if he aids her.
scenes.title: The Elders Forbid the Charts

scenes.conflict: Her private measurements contradict her prophecy, and she refuses to examine them.
scenes.goal: Sorrel wants to keep the isles at peace through acceptance by stopping Iselle's maps from spreading.
scenes.outcome: Sorrel sends word to the enclaves that the maps are heresy, which makes Iselle's journey harder.
scenes.summary: At Ostrelune, High Warden Sorrel hears that Iselle's maps are circulating and declares them heresy. She resolves to stop them from reaching the other enclaves, while declining to look at her own contradicting measurements.
scenes.title: The Warden's Decree

scenes.conflict: A rising cloud tide strains the span, and Orlan hides the truth about the crossing that killed Iselle's mother.
scenes.goal: Reach Vellamar and seek silverthread for the keystones.
scenes.outcome: They arrive safely, but Iselle's trust in Orlan frays, and the Threadwright elders refuse their request.
scenes.summary: Iselle and Orlan cross a skybridge as the cloud tide shifts. Orlan reads the tide and they reach Vellamar under the Oath of Passage, but he deflects Iselle's questions about her mother.
scenes.title: Crossing to Vellamar

scenes.conflict: Threadwright elders guard the supply, and Maren's impulsive lies draw their notice.
scenes.goal: Maren wants to deliver silverthread to a keystone repair against her guild's wishes.
scenes.outcome: Maren leaves with the thread and gives Iselle a way onward, but she is caught and exposed before her guild.
scenes.summary: Maren lies her way past her guild's guards and steals silverthread. Iselle befriends her, and Maren decides to carry the thread to a keystone repair at Cindrelle.
scenes.title: Maren's Silverthread

scenes.conflict: Her loyalty to the guild clashes with her conviction that its leverage is killing the realm.
scenes.goal: Maren wants to justify her act and keep the thread in her possession.
scenes.outcome: The guild is split and Maren is allowed to leave, though not under its protection.
scenes.summary: Caught, Maren must publicly justify the theft. She drops her lies and tells the guild plainly that hoarding thread is stranding the harbor towns.
scenes.title: Maren Speaks the Truth

scenes.conflict: The matriarchs forbid sharing techniques with Threadwrights, and Tavrin's habit of deferring to authority makes him hesitate.
scenes.goal: Tavrin wants to carve a new rune-stone and test it with Threadwright silverthread.
scenes.outcome: Tavrin quietly agrees to the test, but only in secret.
scenes.summary: Maren and Iselle arrive at Cindrelle and claim hospitality. Tavrin, who distrusts Threadwrights, must host them.
scenes.title: Oath of Passage at Cindrelle

scenes.conflict: The matriarchs discover the test, and Tavrin must choose between clan law and the proof in his hands.
scenes.goal: Prove that rune-stone and silverthread joined together can hold a bridge.
scenes.outcome: The test holds, Tavrin openly shares the technique, and the three agree to carry the proof to Ostrelune.
scenes.summary: In the amber caverns, Tavrin and Maren join rune-stone and silverthread in a keystone, and it holds. Iselle's charts show the repair slows the decay nearby.
scenes.title: The Keystone Test

scenes.conflict: Orlan's guilt and his habit of hiding painful truths conflict with Iselle's need to lead.
scenes.goal: Cross the cracked span safely before the tide closes it.
scenes.outcome: Orlan confesses, Iselle forgives him and takes the lead, and they set out for Ostrelune.
scenes.summary: On the cracked southern span, a cloud tide nearly strands the party. Orlan confesses how Iselle's mother died, and then lets Iselle lead the crossing to Ostrelune.
scenes.title: Orlan's Confession

scenes.conflict: Sorrel treats contrary evidence as temptation, and Iselle's trust in numbers over people makes her dismissive of Sorrel's fears.
scenes.goal: Iselle wants Sorrel to accept that the bridges can be saved.
scenes.outcome: Sorrel refuses, and Iselle realizes charts alone will not persuade her.
scenes.summary: Iselle presents her charts and the proof of the repaired keystone to the Starwardens. Sorrel calls the evidence temptation and refuses to look.
scenes.title: Refused at the Observatory

scenes.conflict: Sorrel's fear of panic and her doubt clash with Iselle's confession, and the Circle's elders object to the archive record being shown.
scenes.goal: Iselle wants to earn Sorrel's trust through honest testimony and persuade the enclaves to rejoin rune-stone and silverthread.
scenes.outcome: Sorrel faces her doubt, opens the observatories, and lends the Starwardens' calculations to the repair, uniting all four enclaves.
scenes.summary: Iselle opens the archive's stolen-chart record and publicly admits Lumenvale's old wrong behind the Closing of the Archive. Sorrel's private measurements then match Iselle's chart.
scenes.title: The Stolen Chart Admitted

scenes.conflict: Old grudges and the Circle's elders resist, and the cloud tide narrows the time.
scenes.goal: Restore the Heartspan and the failing keystones before the islands drift apart.
scenes.outcome: The Heartspan resonates again and the drift slows, and the Circle agrees to open the archive.
scenes.summary: Using the Starwardens' drift measurements, Iselle's maps, and joint Threadwright and Emberwright work, the enclaves rejoin rune-stone and silverthread in the failing keystones, starting at the Heartspan.
scenes.title: The Keystones Rejoined

scenes.conflict: Elders on each isle are reluctant to give up their leverage and secrets.
scenes.goal: Secure lasting cooperation among the enclaves.
scenes.outcome: A shared charter is sealed, and Orlan lets Iselle go as a trusted envoy.
scenes.summary: The enclaves pledge shared craft and open archives. Maren speaks for sharing silverthread, Tavrin leads reform among the clans, and Iselle is named envoy.
scenes.title: A New Charter of the Isles

logline: When young cartographer Iselle Vantor charts the pattern behind the failing skybridges, she must win over four suspicious enclaves, and a prophecy-bound High Warden, to rejoin rune-stone and silverthread before the Aurelian Drift scatters beyond reach.
theme: Unity is mended by honest listening, not certainty alone
title: The Skybridge Chronicles
